candidate_workaround: Use complete independent Apply Patch sections for each updated or added file and close each hunk before starting another file section.
failure_signature: A corrective Apply Patch embedded an Add File directive inside an unfinished Update File hunk and failed verification before applying anything.
recurrence_guard: Before submitting a multi-file patch, verify that every context hunk is complete and every new file starts in its own top-level patch section.
rollback: Treat verification failure as no mutation, retain the malformed patch fault, inspect the intended hunks, and resubmit only well-formed independent sections.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local additive editing recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Separate multi-file Apply Patch sections
trigger_preconditions: one patch updates and adds multiple files
